change: First C4 methodology. downtime_window records (C4.1, #13257) derive the complete-downtime interval by intersecting the Stage-3 S1 per-pool wall intervals [wall, reset) across every routing pool (keyed by canonical provider id), basis since_last_reset; the prediction range is [latest member wall, earliest member reset), rendered by the §4 formatter at issuance. Providers the forecast cannot project publish insufficient_history and veto a no-window verdict; a defensible no-window tick publishes no record. No day-type or spike-day adjustments (inputs.adjustments is []).
expected_effect: Downtime-window predictions exist on every gatherer tick and are scorable per design §3 (start/end error, interval overlap); §3's accuracy bar is coverage inside the calibrated band with median window error under one gatherer tick span at one-tick lead.
reason: The C4 design (doc/2026-11-13T15-12-00Z_design_reporting-architecture-event-driven/c4-forecasting-design.md, PR #13268) specifies the record, scoring, and methodology-log formats, and S1's same-period pace projection is the only measured per-pool wall source; §5 adjustments are data-gated below their sufficiency thresholds.

change: model_plan_arrival records (C4.4, #13260) now render their prediction range with the one shared §4 formatter (renderPredictionRange in quota-downtime.ts: duration, day, compound, and calendar forms) instead of this kind's own two-form copy in quota-arrival.ts, which is deleted. Stored rendered strings for arrival ranges change accordingly (a range crossing a Chicago day boundary now renders in calendar form, e.g. "between Wednesday evening and this evening", where the kind-local renderer emitted a days-from-now string). The downtime_window and reset_duration kinds are unchanged — the shared formatter was already their method — and keep naming c4-meth:1.
evidence: #13357 (PR #13406, FDR-0013: the design is right; one formatter produces rendered)
expected_effect: Every C4 kind's stored rendered string comes from the single §4 formatter, so a rendering fix or form change lands for all kinds at once; arrival records issued under c4-meth:2 are attributable to the unified method, and pre-unification c4-meth:1 arrival records keep their original strings for scoring.
reason: The design (§4) says rendered is produced by one formatter, but quota-arrival.ts carried its own renderPredictionRange with only the duration and day forms (no compound, no calendar), so identical ranges rendered differently by kind. #13408 files the unification as a methodology-visible change requiring this log entry and the version bump, not a silent edit.
